name: AlphaESS ModBus TCP
description: AlphaESS inverter communication via ModBus TCP/IP
author: Wolffie

collector.description: Collects real-time data via ModBus TCP every 10 seconds

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Added readInverterMode() to api.js — reads register 0x0440 (INV_WORK_MODE)
Grid outage detection: raises error alert when inverter switches to UPS/Backup mode
Grid recovery detection: auto-resolves alert when grid returns to Online
Both outage and recovery transitions logged to system_events (category: SAFETY)
Registered grid:status capability — returns { gridConnected, mode }
alertService.js migrated to SQLite: DATE_SUB → datetime(), INSERT IGNORE → INSERT OR IGNORE, NOW() → datetime('now')

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Timestamps written in local time (CET/CEST) to match all other collectors
load_power and load_energy_today removed — now derived by wolffie-core collectorManager

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: NULL for unowned/unavailable fields instead of 0 to prevent AVG() dilution in aggregation

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Daily energy counters derived via midnight baseline stored in system_settings
Baseline bootstrapped automatically on first run

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Initial release — AlphaESS SMILE G3-T10 ModBus TCP collector
Battery, grid, solar and system register reads
Dispatch control: charge, discharge, stop, timed sessions
Failover to AlphaESS Cloud API when ModBus unavailable
